description: Research r19 (dev only, step-capped, B200 workers): r16 (calibration/research_r16/mal0_st500: r5's recipe with the cosine to 0.1x counted over 500 steps) with training rollouts capped at 896 new tokens while the in-loop dev eval keeps 1,024 (eval_max_new_tokens). By step 400, 20-60 % of r16's dev outputs were truncated at 1,024, and two of its five seeds slid into truncation after step 450. Training under a shorter limit should teach searches that finish with room to spare. Truncated rollouts still get training reward 0 (malformed_reward 0), as in r16.
